title: Terraform module: VPC logging & compliance pipeline (CloudTrail -> S3 -> OpenSearch lifecycle)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: implement a reusable Terraform module to provision VPC-level audit and logging pipeline that reliably ships CloudTrail + VPC Flow Logs to encrypted S3, runs lifecycle policies, and indexes/archives to OpenSearch with ILM and periodic snapshots. Goals: 1) provide a drop-in module for Private (VPC) deployments with sensible defaults (KMS encryption, S3 bucket policies, cross-account support), 2) enforce retention guardrails (hot/warm/cold tiers) configurable per-customer policy, 3) include healthchecks and upgrade path for module consumers, and 4) document operational runbooks and rollout plan for upgrading existing customers. Scope: CloudTrail + VPC Flow Logs ingestion, S3 bucket with immutable-mode support, KMS CMK alias creation, Lambda or Glue job for transformations (if needed), OpenSearch ingest pipeline template, ILM policies + snapshot lifecycle management to S3, Terraform inputs/outputs, examples, and integration tests. Out of scope: custom SIEM integrations (we will provide hooks).
